english.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice when frustration comes with irritation or anger.
This is the all-purpose choice for something that makes people frustrated or fed up.
Use this for exasperation caused by a frustrating or repeatedly irritating situation.

examples.english: I’m really frustrated; the computer froze again.
examples.traditional: 我真係激氣，部電腦又死機喇。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 gik1 hei3 bou6 din6 nou5 jau6 sei2 gei1 laa3

examples.english: They are late to every meeting, which is really provocative.
examples.traditional: 佢次次開會都遲到，真係激氣。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 ci3 ci3 hoi1 wui2 dou1 ci4 dou3 zan1 hai6 gik1 hei3

examples.english: The program keeps crashing, which has really annoyed me.
examples.traditional: 個程式成日死機，搞到我真係激氣。
